questions.question: Which psychologist proposed the stages of cognitive development?
questions.explanation: Jean Piaget proposed the stages of cognitive development.

questions.question: Growth mainly refers to ______.
questions.explanation: Growth refers to quantitative changes such as increase in height and weight.

questions.question: Development is primarily a process of ______.
questions.explanation: Development includes both qualitative and quantitative changes throughout life.

questions.question: Which principle states that development proceeds from head to toe?
questions.explanation: Cephalocaudal principle means development progresses from the head towards the feet.

questions.question: Development from the centre of the body towards the extremities follows which principle?
questions.explanation: Proximodistal development progresses from the centre of the body outward.

questions.question: The term 'maturation' refers to ______.
questions.explanation: Maturation is the natural unfolding of biological potential determined by heredity.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of development?
questions.explanation: Development is a continuous process from conception to death.

questions.question: Individual differences in development mean that ______.

options.A: All children develop at the same rate
options.D: Growth is identical in all children

questions.explanation: Children differ in the rate and pattern of development.

questions.question: The interaction of heredity and environment influences ______.
questions.explanation: Development is influenced by both heredity and environment.

questions.question: Development follows a ______ pattern.
questions.explanation: Development follows an orderly and predictable sequence though the rate may vary.
